headline: Somalia Added to U.S. Coast Guard Port Security Risk List
summary: Ships arriving from Somali ports face U.S. Coast Guard conditions of entry, joining 23 other nations on the port security risk list.
why: Port security advisories and conditions of entry imposed by maritime authorities can impact shipping logistics, insurance costs, and maritime trade routes.

impacts.name: Somalia
impacts.why: New port security conditions apply to vessels arriving from the country.
